expect_customer_portal_reason: Homepage promises live tracking, but there is no tracking page, customer login or quote form.
ops_signals: Loads booked by phone; quotes by email within 2 business days

extra_findings.title: Promises 24/7 tracking it can't show
extra_findings.evidence: Homepage: '24/7 Live Shipment Tracking'. Contact page: Monday to Friday, 9:00 - 17:00. No tracking page.
extra_findings.impact: Shippers notice when claims and reality don't match.

extra_findings.title: Social links go nowhere
extra_findings.evidence: Facebook and Twitter links point to '#'.
